partition.description: partition types (user 2026-11-05): CPU (DMIPS), RAM and ROM (kB) per partition, one ASIL per partition, up to site.max_partitions per cell, any mix; prices include the external memory; no TOPS (the GPU is per-cell hardware, hardwares.json HW_ACC types)

site.description: Caps and fixed activation cost of the control unit at a cell (the single unit size of configs/vehicle.json installation_space.ecu_size): at most max_partitions partitions, and the hosted demand of the whole unit (sum over all its partitions, with the demand margins and hot standbys, as in the partition capacity constraint) at most cpu/ram/rom_cap times the site derating (same units as the partition capacities). null = unlimited, fixed_cost 0 = free. Provisional values 2026-10-20 (two partitions' worth of compute, four partitions) until the data pass. switch_node_cost (2026-10-30): the same unit cost for a cell that holds only a switch and no software (its own housing, supply and mounting); 0 = the switch chip only (hardwares.json), the model before 2026-10-30.
site.cost_source: no housing cost per cell (user 2026-11-04: 'there should be no such cost')
